Original · Unique Research · 2025-11-21

Historical edition note: This is a full English rendition of Unique Research’s article published on November 21, 2025. The figures, selection judgments, and references to “today,” “this year,” and the future reflect the original 2025 publication, not a new selection or current assessment. The original does not specify a measurement period for every global traffic figure.

610 million downloads and 11.716 billion visits.

Globally, 376 AI Apps and 2,312 AI Web products are already active in people’s browsers. Of these, Chinese AI Apps have reached 237 million downloads (2.37 × 100 million), while Chinese AI Web products attract 1.375 billion visits annually (13.75 × 100 million), making China an increasingly important pole of global AI traffic and innovation. Among products serving users worldwide, 71 Chinese AI Apps and 222 Chinese AI Web products have expanded overseas.

In 2025, a year thoroughly rewritten by AI, we set out to answer one question:

Across this rapidly expanding “new continent,” who is truly moving Chinese AI forward?

Today, the answer is revealed.

Behind every name is a builder who, amid 610 million downloads and 11.716 billion visits, is genuinely turning AI into products and user value.

You can find your company, press and hold to save the list as a small “medal” for your team, or share it with colleagues and friends to see which forces in Chinese AI deserve sustained attention this year.

Since 2023, Unique Research has organized the annual “CHINA AI 100” ranking to use systematic research and long-term tracking to identify a cohort of truly AI-native companies—businesses built on AI at their foundation and unable to exist independently without it.

Over the past two years, we have seen a growing number of Chinese teams take on more important positions in the global AI landscape:

Some continue to deliver breakthroughs in foundation models and multimodal models;

Some are strengthening the “new infrastructure” through AI Infra, MaaS, and computing-power platforms;

Some are bringing Agents, productivity tools, industry applications, digital employees, and intelligent hardware into real business scenarios;

And another group of products expanding overseas is bringing Chinese AI capabilities to users around the world.

This year’s “2025 CHINA AI 100” is a concentrated presentation of these forces.

How did we select these 100 companies?

To assess every company as fairly and comprehensively as possible, this year’s selection process adhered to the following principles from the outset:

AI Native: AI must be central to the company’s construction, from its underlying technology to its business model;

Full-chain assessment: Coverage spans the model layer and middle-layer platforms through 2C / 2ProC / 2B applications and intelligent hardware;

Multidimensional evaluation: The selection applies the four-dimensional TPES framework—Technology leadership, Product competitiveness, Economic growth potential, and Social Value—combining user and enterprise research + expert-review scoring.

The companies included in this ranking are therefore not merely those that “look hot.” They are Chinese AI-native benchmarks that withstand scrutiny across technology, products, business, and social value and demonstrate the momentum for long-term growth.

Witness the benchmarks among China’s AI-native enterprises and empower the high-quality development of the AI industry.

Thank you to every company that participated in this year’s selection, and congratulations to every company on the list.

AI’s new cycle has only just begun.

We look forward to seeing both more familiar names and many new ones on next year’s list.
